bibl.title: Ptolemy I and the Succession Issue.
bibl.seg: Ian Worthington, Ptolemy I and the Succession Issue.
bibl.note: Puts forward two hitherto unexplored explanations for the choice of Ptolemy I to set aside his eldest son Ptolemy Ceraunus and instead to make his younger son Ptolemy (by Berenice) his successor. First, Ptolemy's relations with Eurydice and Berenice, and second, Ceraunus' own ambitions as they pertained to mastery of Greece and Macedonia.
